name: Upload merged DocupletionForms PDFs to Google Drive

parameters.content:
## Upload merged DocupletionForms PDFs to Google Drive

![Workflow overview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/alfa-intellitech/n8n-nodes-docupletionforms/main/templates/images/merged-document-to-google-drive.png)

**Uses the verified [n8n-nodes-docupletionforms](https://www.npmjs.com/package/n8n-nodes-docupletionforms) node — available on n8n Cloud and self-hosted instances.**

### Who's it for
Teams using [DocupletionForms](https://docupletionforms.com) who want every merged PDF (contracts, intake forms, generated documents) automatically archived to Google Drive instead of downloading them manually.

### How it works
The DocupletionForms Trigger fires the *Document Merged* event whenever a submission is merged into a PDF for a chosen document set. The delivered file URL is downloaded via an HTTP Request node, then uploaded to Google Drive under its original file name.

### How to set up
1. Add your DocupletionForms API credential and pick the Document Set to watch.
2. Add your Google Drive credential and choose (or leave default) the destination folder.

### Requirements
- n8n (Cloud or self-hosted) with `n8n-nodes-docupletionforms` installed — on Cloud, enable it under Settings → Community Nodes; verified nodes are approved for Cloud installs.
- A DocupletionForms account and API key.
- A Google Drive account connected via OAuth2.

### How to customize
Point the upload at a specific shared drive/folder, or swap Google Drive for another storage node (Dropbox, S3, OneDrive) — the HTTP Request node's binary output works the same way with any of them.

### Step 1
Set up your DocupletionForms credential, then pick the Document Set to watch below.

### Step 2
Set up your Google Drive credential and choose a destination folder (defaults to My Drive root).
